4. Opposite party Nos. 1 & 2, as defendant nos. 1 & 2, contested the suit by filing written statement denying material allegations of the plaint and contended, inter alia, that by Kabala dated 10-10-1964 Bachani Bibi and Kaich Bibi in fact mortgaged the property for a period of 5 years and after the expiry of said 5 years Bachani and Kaich Bibi got back the property in accordance with the provision of President's Order No. 88 of 1972; Bachani Bibi and Kaich Bibi, after getting back the property, while possessing the same, sold the same along with other land, to the defendant No. 1 & 2 by registered sale deed dated 10-3-1975, 19-5-1975, 5-2-1974, 3-8-1977 and 10-3-1975. The plaintiff has no right, title and interest in the suit land; they sought for separate saham for their purchased land. 

 9. Having perused the pleadings and other materials it appears that, prior to coming into force of President's Order No. 88 of 1972, a transaction by way of out and out sale coupled with an agreement for re-conveyance by itself, does not constitute as complete usufructuary mortgage but after promulgation of President's Order No. 88 of 1972 on 3-8-1972 section 95A was incorporated in the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act which is as follows : 

 "95A.—Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, any transfer of a holding or of a portion or share thereof, where the transferor receives from the transferee any consideration and the transferee acquires the right to possess, and to enjoy the usufruct of such holding or portion or share thereof for a specified period in lieu of such consideration, shall notwithstanding any-thing contained in the document relating to the transfer, be deemed to be a complete usufructuary mortgage for a period not exceeding seven years and the provisions of Section 95 shall apply to such transfer whether made before or after the date of commencement of the State Acquisition and Tenancy (Second Amendment) Order, 1972." 

 11. Thereafter by President's Order No. 24 of 1973, sub-section (4) and (5) of section 95 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act was substituted.
